name: Damage Loins
body:
School necromancy [evil]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one living humanoid creature
Duration instantaneous; see text
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You afflict a target creature with a painful contusion of the groin. The target takes 1d6 points of damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d6), may only move at half speed, and becomes sickened for ld4 rounds.
